# `mise history paths`

- **Usage:** `mise history paths`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/history/mod.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/history/mod.rs)

Show what history tracks and under which policies

Every entry is listed with the file that declared it, its policies, and
how many files it currently covers. Declarations history could not
honour are listed as invalid so a failed enrollment is never mistaken
for protection.

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--preview <PATH>`** — Show what tracking this path would capture
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`mise history paths add [FLAGS] <PATH>…`](/cli/history/paths/add.md)
- [`mise history paths remove <PATH>…`](/cli/history/paths/remove.md)
- [`mise history paths set [FLAGS] <PATH>…`](/cli/history/paths/set.md)
